text: That yellow stain on your teeth can disappear in under two minutes. In Chinese medicine, we have had the remedy for this all along. The industry charges you thousands for what is already sitting in your kitchen. Most people who come to me with this problem have stopped smiling openly in photos. They cover their mouth when they laugh. They have tried every whitening strip, every toothpaste, and nothing lasts. Listen to me. This is exactly what you need to do. Take a banana peel and mash the inner part into a bowl. Add one teaspoon of lemon juice, one teaspoon of salt, and one teaspoon of toothpaste. Mix it all together. Brush your teeth with this mixture for two minutes. You will notice the difference immediately. The salt fights the buildup. The lemon lifts the stain. The banana peel works with your enamel instead of against it. This is ancient knowledge, not a new discovery. Store what is left in the refrigerator. It lasts up to three weeks. But here is what nobody tells you. Why did it happen in the first place? In Chinese medicine, the gut and the mouth are far more connected than people think. What the gut cannot clean the mouth carries. The color of your teeth, bad breath, inflamed gums. These are almost never a hygiene problem. They are your body telling you that something inside is not working properly. And what damages the gut is not just food. It is the stress you accumulate every day. The emotions you swallow without releasing. The tension that has become your normal way of living. All of that inflames the gut. Disrupts the bacteria in your mouth. And ends up showing on your teeth. You can whiten them every week. If on the inside, nothing changes. The stain will keep coming back. Write in the comments. Smile. If you are going to try this today. And if you want to learn how to cleanse your body from the root. Not just the teeth. But what is staining them from the inside. To calm the stress that inflames. To release what your gut cannot process. And to truly take care of yourself from where it all begins. I spent over twenty years learning in silence. How to do exactly that. And everything I know is inside the way back to stillness. The link is in my profile.

segments.t: That yellow stain on your teeth can disappear in under two minutes.
In Chinese medicine, we have had the remedy for this all along.
The industry charges you thousands for what is already sitting in your kitchen.
Most people who come to me with this problem have stopped smiling openly in photos.
They cover their mouth when they laugh.
They have tried every whitening strip, every toothpaste, and nothing lasts.
Listen to me. This is exactly what you need to do.
Take a banana peel and mash the inner part into a bowl.
Add one teaspoon of lemon juice, one teaspoon of salt, and one teaspoon of toothpaste.
Mix it all together.
Brush your teeth with this mixture for two minutes.
You will notice the difference immediately.
The salt fights the buildup.
The lemon lifts the stain.
The banana peel works with your enamel instead of against it.
This is ancient knowledge, not a new discovery.
Store what is left in the refrigerator.
It lasts up to three weeks.
But here is what nobody tells you.
Why did it happen in the first place?
In Chinese medicine, the gut and the mouth are far more connected than people think.
What the gut cannot clean the mouth carries.
The color of your teeth, bad breath, inflamed gums.
These are almost never a hygiene problem.
They are your body telling you that something inside is not working properly.
And what damages the gut is not just food.
It is the stress you accumulate every day.
The emotions you swallow without releasing.
The tension that has become your normal way of living.
All of that inflames the gut.
Disrupts the bacteria in your mouth.
